{
  "name": "@beep/architecture-lab-proof",
  "version": "0.0.2",
  "description": "App-level contract harness for the architecture-lab WorkItem proof.",
  "license": "MIT",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/beep-effect/beep-effect/tree/main/apps/architecture-lab-proof",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git@github.com:beep-effect/beep-effect.git",
    "directory": "apps/architecture-lab-proof"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "audit": "bun run --if-present beep:audit",
    "babel": "babel dist --plugins annotate-pure-calls --out-dir dist --source-maps",
    "beep:audit": "bun run beep:build && bun run beep:check && bun run beep:test && bun run beep:test:integration && bun run beep:lint",
    "beep:build": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.json && bun run babel",
    "beep:check": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.check.json && bun run beep:check:tests",
    "beep:check:tests": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit",
    "beep:docgen": "bunx --bun --no-install docgen",
    "beep:lint": "biome check .",
    "beep:lint:fix": "biome check . --write",
    "beep:test": "bunx --bun vitest run --passWithNoTests --exclude=test/integration/**",
    "beep:test:integration": "bunx --bun vitest run test/integration --passWithNoTests",
    "build": "bun run beep:build",
    "check": "bun run beep:check",
    "coverage": "bunx vitest run --coverage --exclude=test/integration/**",
    "docgen": "bun run beep:docgen",
    "lint": "bun run beep:lint",
    "lint:deprecated-apis": "beep-cli lint deprecated-apis --package .",
    "lint:fix": "bun run beep:lint:fix",
    "lint:jsdoc": "beep-cli lint jsdoc --package .",
    "lint:laws": "beep-cli lint laws --package .",
    "package-test-typecheck": "beep-cli quality test-tsgo-package",
    "test": "bun run beep:test",
    "test:integration": "bun run beep:test:integration",
    "test:property": "bun run beep:test"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./internal/*": null,
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  },
  "files": [
    "src/**/*.ts",
    "dist/**/*.js",
    "dist/**/*.js.map",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts.map"
  ],
  "sideEffects": [],
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public",
    "provenance": true,
    "exports": {
      ".": "./dist/index.ts",
      "./internal/*": null,
      "./package.json": "./package.json"
    }
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@beep/architecture-lab-config": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/architecture-lab-domain": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/architecture-lab-server": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/architecture-lab-ui": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/architecture-lab-use-cases": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/identity": "workspace:^",
    "effect": "catalog:"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@beep/test-runner": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/test-utils": "workspace:^",
    "@effect/vitest": "catalog:",
    "@types/node": "catalog:"
  }
}

  "version": "0.0.0",
  "description": "Practice document identification: resolves the client and docket of unplaced documents with measured precision per evidence tier.",

  "private": true,

  "homepage": "https://github.com/beep-effect/beep-effect/tree/main/apps/practice-identify",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git@github.com:beep-effect/beep-effect.git",
    "directory": "apps/practice-identify"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "audit": "bun run --if-present beep:audit",

    "beep:test": "bunx --bun vitest run",
    "build": "bun run beep:build",
    "check": "bun run beep:check",
    "coverage": "bunx vitest run --coverage",
    "lint": "bun run beep:lint",
    "lint:deprecated-apis": "beep-cli lint deprecated-apis --package .",
    "lint:fix": "bun run beep:lint:fix",
    "lint:jsdoc": "beep-cli lint jsdoc --package .",
    "lint:laws": "beep-cli lint laws --package .",
    "package-test-typecheck": "beep-cli quality test-tsgo-package",
    "test": "bun run beep:test"
  },
  "bin": {
    "practice-identify": "./src/bin.ts"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@beep/identity": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/law-practice-server": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/law-practice-use-cases": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/schema": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/uspto": "workspace:^",
    "@effect/platform-bun": "catalog:",
    "effect": "catalog:"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@effect/platform-node": "catalog:",
    "@effect/vitest": "catalog:",
    "@types/node": "catalog:",
    "typescript": "catalog:"
  }
}

  "name": "@beep/practice-kg-mcp",
  "version": "0.0.0",
  "description": "Local practice knowledge-graph bundle builder and MCP host.",
  "license": "MIT",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/kriegcloud/beep-effect/tree/main/apps/practice-kg-mcp",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git@github.com:kriegcloud/beep-effect.git",
    "directory": "apps/practice-kg-mcp"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "audit": "bun run --if-present beep:audit",
    "beep:audit": "bun run beep:build && bun run beep:check && bun run beep:test && bun run beep:lint",
    "beep:build": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.json",
    "beep:check": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.check.json && bun run beep:check:tests",
    "beep:check:tests": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit",
    "beep:docgen": "bunx --bun --no-install docgen",
    "beep:lint": "biome check .",
    "beep:lint:fix": "biome check . --write",
    "beep:test": "bunx --bun vitest run --passWithNoTests",
    "build": "bun run beep:build",
    "check": "bun run beep:check",
    "coverage": "bunx vitest run --coverage --exclude=test/integration/**",
    "docgen": "bun run beep:docgen",
    "lint": "bun run beep:lint",
    "lint:deprecated-apis": "beep-cli lint deprecated-apis --package .",
    "lint:fix": "bun run beep:lint:fix",
    "lint:jsdoc": "beep-cli lint jsdoc --package .",
    "lint:laws": "beep-cli lint laws --package .",
    "package-test-typecheck": "beep-cli quality test-tsgo-package",
    "package:mcpb": "bun run src/package.ts",
    "package:mcpb:linux": "bun run src/package.ts --target linux-x64",
    "smoke:compiled": "bun run package:mcpb:linux && bun run src/smoke.ts",
    "test": "bun run beep:test"
  },
  "bin": {
    "practice-kg-build": "./src/build.ts",
    "practice-kg-claims": "./src/claims.ts",
    "practice-kg-mcp": "./src/bin.ts",
    "practice-kg-verify": "./src/verify.ts"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@beep/anthropic": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/duckdb": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/identity": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/law-practice-server": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/mcpb-kit": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/observability": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/pglite": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/schema": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/utils": "workspace:^",
    "@effect/platform-bun": "catalog:",
    "@electric-sql/pglite": "catalog:",
    "effect": "catalog:"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@beep/mcp-kit": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/memfs": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/test-runner": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/test-utils": "workspace:^",
    "@effect/vitest": "catalog:",
    "@types/node": "catalog:"
  }
}

{
  "name": "@beep/storybook",
  "version": "0.0.0",
  "description": "Executable Storybook host for foundation UI-system package stories.",
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/beep-effect/beep-effect/tree/main/apps/storybook",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git@github.com:beep-effect/beep-effect.git",
    "directory": "apps/storybook"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "audit": "bun run --if-present beep:audit",
    "beep:audit": "bun run beep:build && bun run beep:check && bun run beep:test && bun run beep:lint",
    "beep:build": "bun run storybook:build",
    "beep:check": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.check.json && tsc-rs -p tsconfig.stories.json --noEmit",
    "beep:lint": "sh -c 'biome check package.json postcss.config.mjs tsconfig.json tsconfig.stories.json vitest.config.ts vitest.storybook.config.ts vitest.storybook.setup.ts .storybook/ scripts/ \"$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)\"/packages/foundation/ui-system/*/stories/'",
    "beep:lint:fix": "sh -c 'biome check package.json postcss.config.mjs tsconfig.json tsconfig.stories.json vitest.config.ts vitest.storybook.config.ts vitest.storybook.setup.ts .storybook/ scripts/ \"$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)\"/packages/foundation/ui-system/*/stories/ --write'",
    "beep:test": "bunx --bun vitest run --passWithNoTests",
    "build": "bun run beep:build",
    "check": "bun run beep:check",
    "lint": "bun run beep:lint",
    "lint:deprecated-apis": "beep-cli lint deprecated-apis --package .",
    "lint:fix": "bun run beep:lint:fix",
    "lint:jsdoc": "beep-cli lint jsdoc --package .",
    "lint:laws": "beep-cli lint laws --package .",
    "package-test-typecheck": "beep-cli quality test-tsgo-package",
    "storybook": "portless storybook.beep sh -c 'storybook dev -p \"${PORT:-6006}\"'",
    "storybook:build": "NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=DEP0205 storybook build -o storybook-static",
    "storybook:start": "portless storybook.beep sh -c 'vite preview --host 0.0.0.0 --port \"${PORT:-6006}\" --outDir storybook-static'",
    "test": "bun run beep:test",
    "test:storybook": "bun run scripts/run-storybook-tests.mjs",
    "test:storybook:dock-react": "bun run scripts/run-storybook-tests.mjs \"$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/packages/foundation/ui-system/dock-react/stories\"",
    "test:storybook:editor": "bun run scripts/run-storybook-tests.mjs \"$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/packages/foundation/ui-system/editor/stories\"",
    "test:storybook:graph-3d": "bun run scripts/run-storybook-tests.mjs \"$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/packages/drivers/graph-3d/stories\"",
    "test:storybook:ui": "bun run scripts/run-storybook-tests.mjs \"$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/packages/foundation/ui-system/ui/stories\""
  },
  "sideEffects": [
    "**/*.css"
  ],
  "dependencies": {
    "@beep/epistemic-ui": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/graph-3d": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/ui": "workspace:^",
    "@storybook/addon-a11y": "catalog:",
    "@storybook/addon-docs": "catalog:",
    "@storybook/addon-themes": "catalog:",

}

  "name": "@beep/infra",
  "version": "0.0.4",
  "description": "Pulumi infrastructure workspace for beep-effect",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/beep-effect/beep-effect/tree/main/infra",

    "type": "git",
    "url": "git@github.com:beep-effect/beep-effect.git",
    "directory": "infra"

  "scripts": {
    "audit": "bun run --if-present beep:audit",
    "beep:audit": "bun run beep:build && bun run beep:check && bun run beep:test && bun run beep:lint",
    "beep:build": "echo 'no build needed'",
    "beep:check": "tsc-rs -b tsconfig.json && bun run beep:check:tests",
    "beep:check:tests": "tsc-rs -p test/tsconfig.json --noEmit",
    "beep:coverage": "bun run --cwd node_modules/@pulumi/gharunners build && bunx vitest run --coverage --exclude=test/integration/**",
    "beep:docgen": "bunx --bun --no-install docgen",
    "beep:lint": "biome check src/ test/",
    "beep:lint:fix": "biome check src/ test/ --write",
    "beep:test": "bunx --bun vitest run --passWithNoTests && bun run test:lambda",
    "build": "bun run beep:build",
    "check": "bun run beep:check",
    "coverage": "bun run beep:coverage",
    "docgen": "bun run beep:docgen",
    "lint": "bun run beep:lint",
    "lint:deprecated-apis": "beep-cli lint deprecated-apis --package .",
    "lint:fix": "bun run beep:lint:fix",
    "lint:jsdoc": "beep-cli lint jsdoc --package .",
    "lint:laws": "beep-cli lint laws --package .",
    "package-test-typecheck": "beep-cli quality test-tsgo-package",
    "repo-exports:shard": "beep-cli quality repo-exports-catalog --package-shard",
    "test": "bun run beep:test",
    "test:lambda": "cd lambda/turbo-cache && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run bundle:check && bun run zip:check"
  },
  "main": "src/index.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./package.json": "./package.json"

  "dependencies": {
    "@beep/identity": "workspace:^",

  }
}

{
  "name": "@beep/architecture-lab-config",
  "version": "0.0.1",
  "description": "Architecture-lab typed configuration package for WorkItem proof settings.",
  "license": "MIT",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/beep-effect/beep-effect/tree/main/packages/architecture-lab/config",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git@github.com:beep-effect/beep-effect.git",
    "directory": "packages/architecture-lab/config"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "audit": "bun run --if-present beep:audit",
    "babel": "babel dist --plugins annotate-pure-calls --out-dir dist --source-maps",
    "beep:audit": "bun run beep:build && bun run beep:check && bun run beep:test && bun run beep:test:integration && bun run beep:lint",
    "beep:build": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.json && bun run babel",
    "beep:check": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.check.json && bun run beep:check:tests",
    "beep:check:tests": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit",
    "beep:docgen": "bunx --bun --no-install docgen",
    "beep:lint": "biome check .",
    "beep:lint:fix": "biome check . --write",
    "beep:test": "bunx --bun vitest run --passWithNoTests --exclude=test/integration/**",
    "beep:test:integration": "bunx --bun vitest run test/integration --passWithNoTests",
    "build": "bun run beep:build",
    "check": "bun run beep:check",
    "coverage": "bunx vitest run --coverage --exclude=test/integration/**",
    "docgen": "bun run beep:docgen",
    "lint": "bun run beep:lint",
    "lint:deprecated-apis": "beep-cli lint deprecated-apis --package .",
    "lint:fix": "bun run beep:lint:fix",
    "lint:jsdoc": "beep-cli lint jsdoc --package .",
    "lint:laws": "beep-cli lint laws --package .",
    "package-test-typecheck": "beep-cli quality test-tsgo-package",
    "test": "bun run beep:test",
    "test:integration": "bun run beep:test:integration",
    "test:property": "bun run beep:test"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./aggregates/WorkItem": "./src/aggregates/WorkItem/index.ts",
    "./internal/*": null,
    "./layer": "./src/layer.ts",
    "./package.json": "./package.json",
    "./public": "./src/public.ts",
    "./secrets": "./src/secrets.ts",
    "./server": "./src/server.ts",
    "./test": "./src/test.ts"
  },
  "files": [
    "src/**/*.ts",
    "dist/**/*.js",
    "dist/**/*.js.map",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts.map"
  ],
  "sideEffects": [],
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public",
    "provenance": true,
    "exports": {
      ".": "./dist/index.ts",
      "./aggregates/WorkItem": "./dist/aggregates/WorkItem/index.js",
      "./internal/*": null,
      "./layer": "./dist/layer.js",
      "./package.json": "./package.json",
      "./public": "./dist/public.js",
      "./secrets": "./dist/secrets.js",
      "./server": "./dist/server.js",
      "./test": "./dist/test.js"
    }
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@beep/identity": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/schema": "workspace:^",
    "effect": "catalog:"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@beep/test-runner": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/test-utils": "workspace:^",
    "@effect/vitest": "catalog:",
    "@types/node": "catalog:"
  }
}

{
  "name": "@beep/architecture-lab-use-cases",
  "version": "0.0.2",
  "description": "Architecture-lab use-case package for WorkItem commands, queries, ports, and public action contracts.",
  "license": "MIT",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/beep-effect/beep-effect/tree/main/packages/architecture-lab/use-cases",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git@github.com:beep-effect/beep-effect.git",
    "directory": "packages/architecture-lab/use-cases"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "audit": "bun run --if-present beep:audit",
    "babel": "babel dist --plugins annotate-pure-calls --out-dir dist --source-maps",
    "beep:audit": "bun run beep:build && bun run beep:check && bun run beep:test && bun run beep:test:integration && bun run beep:lint",
    "beep:build": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.json && bun run babel",
    "beep:check": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.check.json && bun run beep:check:tests",
    "beep:check:tests": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit",
    "beep:docgen": "bunx --bun --no-install docgen",
    "beep:lint": "biome check .",
    "beep:lint:fix": "biome check . --write",
    "beep:test": "bunx --bun vitest run --passWithNoTests --exclude=test/integration/**",
    "beep:test:integration": "bunx --bun vitest run test/integration --passWithNoTests",
    "build": "bun run beep:build",
    "check": "bun run beep:check",
    "coverage": "bunx vitest run --coverage --exclude=test/integration/**",
    "docgen": "bun run beep:docgen",
    "lint": "bun run beep:lint",
    "lint:deprecated-apis": "beep-cli lint deprecated-apis --package .",
    "lint:fix": "bun run beep:lint:fix",
    "lint:jsdoc": "beep-cli lint jsdoc --package .",
    "lint:laws": "beep-cli lint laws --package .",
    "package-test-typecheck": "beep-cli quality test-tsgo-package",
    "test": "bun run beep:test",
    "test:integration": "bun run beep:test:integration",
    "test:property": "bun run beep:test"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./aggregates/WorkItem": "./src/aggregates/WorkItem/index.ts",
    "./aggregates/WorkItem/server": "./src/aggregates/WorkItem/server.ts",
    "./entities/Worker": "./src/entities/Worker/index.ts",
    "./entities/Worker/server": "./src/entities/Worker/server.ts",
    "./internal/*": null,
    "./package.json": "./package.json",
    "./public": "./src/public.ts",
    "./server": "./src/server.ts"
  },
  "files": [
    "src/**/*.ts",
    "dist/**/*.js",
    "dist/**/*.js.map",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts.map"
  ],
  "sideEffects": [],
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public",
    "provenance": true,
    "exports": {
      ".": "./dist/index.ts",
      "./aggregates/WorkItem": "./dist/aggregates/WorkItem/index.js",
      "./aggregates/WorkItem/server": "./dist/aggregates/WorkItem/server.js",
      "./entities/Worker": "./dist/entities/Worker/index.js",
      "./entities/Worker/server": "./dist/entities/Worker/server.js",
      "./internal/*": null,
      "./package.json": "./package.json",
      "./public": "./dist/public.js",
      "./server": "./dist/server.js"
    }
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@beep/architecture-lab-domain": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/identity": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/shared-domain": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/utils": "workspace:^",
    "effect": "catalog:"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@beep/test-runner": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/test-utils": "workspace:^",
    "@effect/vitest": "catalog:",
    "@types/node": "catalog:"
  }
}

    "lint:laws": "beep-cli lint laws --package .",
    "package-test-typecheck": "beep-cli quality test-tsgo-package",
    "test": "bun run beep:test",
    "test:integration": "bun run beep:test:integration",
    "test:integration:parallel": "bun run beep:test:integration",
    "test:property": "bun run beep:test"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./_generated/*": null,
    "./agent": "./src/AcpAgent.service.ts",
    "./client": "./src/AcpClient.service.ts",

    "./errors": "./src/Acp.errors.ts",
    "./internal/*": "./src/internal/*.ts",
    "./json": "./src/AcpJson.codec.ts",
    "./package.json": "./package.json",
    "./protocol": "./src/AcpProtocol.service.ts",
    "./rpc": "./src/AcpRpc.models.ts",
    "./schema": "./src/Acp.models.ts",
    "./schema-v1": "./src/AcpV1.models.ts",
    "./stderr": "./src/AcpStderr.models.ts",
    "./terminals": "./src/AcpClientTerminals.service.ts"
  },
  "files": [
    "src/**/*.ts",
    "dist/**/*.js",

    "dist/**/*.d.ts",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts.map"

      "./package.json": "./package.json",
      "./protocol": "./dist/AcpProtocol.service.js",
      "./rpc": "./dist/AcpRpc.models.js",
      "./schema": "./dist/Acp.models.js",
      "./schema-v1": "./dist/AcpV1.models.js",

      "./terminals": "./dist/AcpClientTerminals.service.js"
    }

  "dependencies": {
    "@beep/identity": "workspace:^",

  }
}

    "bun-types": "catalog:"
  }
}

    "build": "bun run beep:build",

    "generate": "bun run scripts/generate.ts",
    "generate:check": "bun run scripts/generate.ts --check",

    "lint:jsdoc": "beep-cli lint jsdoc --package .",
    "lint:laws": "beep-cli lint laws --package .",
    "package-test-typecheck": "beep-cli quality test-tsgo-package",
    "test": "bun run beep:test",
    "test:integration": "bun run beep:test:integration",
    "test:property": "bun run beep:test"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./*": "./src/*.ts",
    "./_generated/*": null,
    "./internal/*": null,
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  },
  "files": [
    "openapi.json",
    "scripts/**/*.ts",
    "src/**/*.ts",
    "dist/**/*.js",
    "dist/**/*.js.map",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts.map"
  ],
  "sideEffects": [],
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public",
    "provenance": true,

      ".": "./dist/index.ts",

      "./package.json": "./package.json"
    }
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@beep/api-transport": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/identity": "workspace:^",

    "@beep/utils": "workspace:^",

  },

    "@beep/codegen-kit": "workspace:^",

    "bun-types": "catalog:"
  }
}

    "build": "bun run beep:build",
    "check": "bun run beep:check",
    "coverage": "bunx vitest run --coverage --exclude=test/integration/**",

    "lint": "bun run beep:lint",

    "test": "bun run beep:test",
    "test:integration": "bun run beep:test:integration",
    "test:property": "bun run beep:test"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./internal/*": null,
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  },
  "files": [
    "src/**/*.ts",
    "dist/**/*.js",
    "dist/**/*.js.map",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts.map"
  ],
  "sideEffects": [],
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public",
    "provenance": true,
    "exports": {
      ".": {
        "default": "./dist/index.js",
        "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
      },
      "./internal/*": null,
      "./package.json": "./package.json"
    }
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@beep/identity": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/schema": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/utils": "workspace:^",
    "effect": "catalog:"
  },

    "@beep/test-runner": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/test-utils": "workspace:^",
    "@effect/vitest": "catalog:",
    "@types/node": "catalog:",

  }
}

  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",

    "./package.json": "./package.json"

    "@beep/test-runner": "workspace:^",

  }
}

  "name": "@beep/api-transport",
  "version": "0.0.0",
  "description": "Shared hand-authored HTTP transport transformer (auth, rate-limit, retry) for gov/legal data drivers.",
  "license": "MIT",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/beep-effect/beep-effect/tree/main/packages/foundation/capability/api-transport",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git@github.com:beep-effect/beep-effect.git",
    "directory": "packages/foundation/capability/api-transport"
  },
  "beep": {
    "family": "foundation",
    "kind": "capability"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "audit": "bun run --if-present beep:audit",
    "babel": "babel dist --plugins annotate-pure-calls --out-dir dist --source-maps",
    "beep:audit": "bun run beep:build && bun run beep:check && bun run beep:test && bun run beep:test:integration && bun run beep:lint",
    "beep:build": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.json && bun run babel",
    "beep:check": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.check.json && bun run beep:check:tests",
    "beep:check:tests": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit",
    "beep:docgen": "bunx --bun --no-install docgen",
    "beep:doctest": "BEEP_VITEST_DOCTEST=1 bunx vitest run",
    "beep:lint": "biome check .",
    "beep:lint:fix": "biome check . --write",
    "beep:test": "bunx --bun vitest run --passWithNoTests --exclude=test/integration/**",
    "beep:test:integration": "bunx --bun vitest run test/integration --passWithNoTests",
    "build": "bun run beep:build",
    "check": "bun run beep:check",
    "coverage": "bunx vitest run --coverage --exclude=test/integration/**",
    "docgen": "bun run beep:docgen",
    "doctest": "bun run beep:doctest",
    "lint": "bun run beep:lint",
    "lint:deprecated-apis": "beep-cli lint deprecated-apis --package .",
    "lint:fix": "bun run beep:lint:fix",
    "lint:jsdoc": "beep-cli lint jsdoc --package .",
    "lint:laws": "beep-cli lint laws --package .",
    "package-test-typecheck": "beep-cli quality test-tsgo-package",
    "test": "bun run beep:test",
    "test:integration": "bun run beep:test:integration",
    "test:property": "bun run beep:test"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./*": "./src/*.ts",
    "./internal/*": null,
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  },
  "files": [
    "src/**/*.ts",
    "dist/**/*.js",
    "dist/**/*.js.map",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts.map"
  ],
  "sideEffects": [],
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public",
    "provenance": true,
    "exports": {
      ".": "./dist/index.ts",
      "./*": "./dist/*.js",
      "./internal/*": null,
      "./package.json": "./package.json"
    }
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@beep/identity": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/schema": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/utils": "workspace:^",
    "effect": "catalog:"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@beep/test-runner": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/test-utils": "workspace:^",
    "@effect/vitest": "catalog:",
    "@types/node": "catalog:",
    "bun-types": "catalog:"
  }
}

{
  "name": "@beep/file-processing",

  "license": "MIT",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",

    "type": "git",
    "url": "git@github.com:beep-effect/beep-effect.git",
    "directory": "packages/foundation/capability/file-processing"
  },
  "beep": {
    "family": "foundation",
    "kind": "capability"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "audit": "bun run --if-present beep:audit",
    "babel": "babel dist --plugins annotate-pure-calls --out-dir dist --source-maps",
    "beep:audit": "bun run beep:build && bun run beep:check && bun run beep:test && bun run beep:test:integration && bun run beep:lint",
    "beep:build": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.json && bun run babel",
    "beep:check": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.check.json && bun run beep:check:tests",
    "beep:check:tests": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit",
    "beep:docgen": "bunx --bun --no-install docgen",
    "beep:doctest": "BEEP_VITEST_DOCTEST=1 bunx vitest run",
    "beep:lint": "biome check .",
    "beep:lint:fix": "biome check . --write",
    "beep:test": "bunx --bun vitest run --passWithNoTests --exclude=test/integration/**",
    "beep:test:integration": "bunx --bun vitest run test/integration --passWithNoTests",
    "build": "bun run beep:build",
    "check": "bun run beep:check",
    "coverage": "bunx vitest run --coverage --exclude=test/integration/**",
    "docgen": "bun run beep:docgen",
    "doctest": "bun run beep:doctest",
    "lint": "bun run beep:lint",
    "lint:deprecated-apis": "beep-cli lint deprecated-apis --package .",
    "lint:fix": "bun run beep:lint:fix",
    "lint:jsdoc": "beep-cli lint jsdoc --package .",
    "lint:laws": "beep-cli lint laws --package .",
    "package-test-typecheck": "beep-cli quality test-tsgo-package",
    "test": "bun run beep:test",
    "test:integration": "bun run beep:test:integration",
    "test:property": "bun run beep:test"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./*": "./src/*.ts",
    "./Artifact": "./src/Artifact/index.ts",
    "./Extraction": "./src/Extraction/index.ts",
    "./Operation": "./src/Operation/index.ts",
    "./PageOcr": "./src/PageOcr/index.ts",
    "./PathSafety": "./src/PathSafety/index.ts",
    "./Service": "./src/Service/index.ts",
    "./SourceText": "./src/SourceText/index.ts",
    "./Strategy": "./src/Strategy/index.ts",
    "./internal/*": null,
    "./package.json": "./package.json",
    "./test": "./src/test.ts"
  },
  "files": [
    "src/**/*.ts",
    "dist/**/*.js",
    "dist/**/*.js.map",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts.map"
  ],
  "sideEffects": [],
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public",
    "provenance": true,
    "exports": {
      ".": "./dist/index.js",
      "./*": "./dist/*.js",
      "./Artifact": "./dist/Artifact/index.js",
      "./Extraction": "./dist/Extraction/index.js",
      "./Operation": "./dist/Operation/index.js",
      "./PageOcr": "./dist/PageOcr/index.js",
      "./PathSafety": "./dist/PathSafety/index.js",
      "./Service": "./dist/Service/index.js",
      "./SourceText": "./dist/SourceText/index.js",
      "./Strategy": "./dist/Strategy/index.js",
      "./internal/*": null,
      "./package.json": "./package.json",
      "./test": "./dist/test.js"
    }
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@beep/identity": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/provenance": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/schema": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/utils": "workspace:^",
    "effect": "catalog:"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@beep/test-runner": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/test-utils": "workspace:^",
    "@effect/platform-bun": "catalog:",
    "@effect/vitest": "catalog:",
    "@types/node": "catalog:",
    "bun-types": "catalog:"
  }
}

{
  "name": "@beep/mcp-kit",
  "version": "0.0.0",
  "description": "Reusable MCP host-construction kit: credential-keyed toolkit composition, api_key_required envelope, tier-gate dispatch, progressive field-tier projection, span hygiene, and the 2026-07-28 stateless client.",
  "license": "MIT",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/beep-effect/beep-effect/tree/main/packages/foundation/capability/mcp-kit",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git@github.com:beep-effect/beep-effect.git",
    "directory": "packages/foundation/capability/mcp-kit"
  },
  "beep": {
    "family": "foundation",
    "kind": "capability"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "audit": "bun run --if-present beep:audit",
    "babel": "babel dist --plugins annotate-pure-calls --out-dir dist --source-maps",
    "beep:audit": "bun run beep:build && bun run beep:check && bun run beep:test && bun run beep:test:integration && bun run beep:lint",
    "beep:build": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.json && bun run babel",
    "beep:check": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.check.json && bun run beep:check:tests",
    "beep:check:tests": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit",
    "beep:docgen": "bunx --bun --no-install docgen",
    "beep:doctest": "BEEP_VITEST_DOCTEST=1 bunx vitest run",
    "beep:lint": "biome check .",
    "beep:lint:fix": "biome check . --write",
    "beep:test": "bunx --bun vitest run --passWithNoTests --exclude=test/integration/**",
    "beep:test:integration": "bunx --bun vitest run test/integration --passWithNoTests",
    "build": "bun run beep:build",
    "check": "bun run beep:check",
    "coverage": "bunx vitest run --coverage --exclude=test/integration/**",
    "docgen": "bun run beep:docgen",
    "doctest": "bun run beep:doctest",
    "lint": "bun run beep:lint",
    "lint:deprecated-apis": "beep-cli lint deprecated-apis --package .",
    "lint:fix": "bun run beep:lint:fix",
    "lint:jsdoc": "beep-cli lint jsdoc --package .",
    "lint:laws": "beep-cli lint laws --package .",
    "package-test-typecheck": "beep-cli quality test-tsgo-package",
    "test": "bun run beep:test",
    "test:integration": "bun run beep:test:integration",
    "test:property": "bun run beep:test"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./*": "./src/*.ts",
    "./client": "./src/client.ts",
    "./client.node": "./src/client.node.ts",
    "./internal/*": null,
    "./package.json": "./package.json",
    "./test/*": "./src/test/*.test-kit.ts"
  },
  "files": [
    "src/**/*.ts",
    "dist/**/*.js",
    "dist/**/*.js.map",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts.map"
  ],
  "sideEffects": [],
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public",
    "provenance": true,
    "exports": {
      ".": "./dist/index.ts",
      "./*": "./dist/*.js",
      "./client": "./dist/client.js",
      "./client.node": "./dist/client.node.js",
      "./internal/*": null,
      "./package.json": "./package.json",
      "./test/*": "./dist/test/*.test-kit.js"
    }
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@beep/identity": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/schema": "workspace:^",
    "effect": "catalog:"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@beep/test-runner": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/test-utils": "workspace:^",
    "@effect/vitest": "catalog:",
    "@types/node": "catalog:",
    "bun-types": "catalog:"
  }
}

{

  },
  "beep": {
    "family": "foundation",
    "kind": "capability"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "audit": "bun run --if-present beep:audit",

    "beep:check:tests": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit",
    "beep:docgen": "bunx --bun --no-install docgen",

    "beep:lint:fix": "biome check . --write",
    "beep:test": "bunx --bun vitest run --passWithNoTests --exclude=test/integration/**",
    "beep:test:integration": "bunx --bun vitest run test/integration --passWithNoTests",
    "build": "bun run beep:build",
    "check": "bun run beep:check",
    "coverage": "bunx vitest run --coverage --exclude=test/integration/**",
    "docgen": "bun run beep:docgen",
    "lint": "bun run beep:lint",
    "lint:deprecated-apis": "beep-cli lint deprecated-apis --package .",
    "lint:fix": "bun run beep:lint:fix",
    "lint:jsdoc": "beep-cli lint jsdoc --package .",
    "lint:laws": "beep-cli lint laws --package .",
    "package-test-typecheck": "beep-cli quality test-tsgo-package",
    "test": "bun run beep:test",
    "test:integration": "bun run beep:test:integration"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./*": "./src/*.ts",
    "./internal/*": "./src/internal/*.ts",
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  },
  "files": [
    "src/**/*.ts",
    "dist/**/*.js",
    "dist/**/*.js.map",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts.map"
  ],
  "sideEffects": [],
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public",
    "provenance": true,
    "exports": {
      ".": "./dist/index.js",
      "./*": "./dist/*.js",
      "./internal/*": "./dist/internal/*.js",
      "./package.json": "./package.json"
    }
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@beep/config-file": "workspace:^",

    "@beep/walker": "workspace:^",
    "effect": "catalog:"
  },

    "@beep/fc-runs": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/memfs": "workspace:^",
    "@effect/vitest": "catalog:",
    "@types/node": "catalog:",
    "bun-types": "catalog:"
  }
}

    "type": "git",

    "directory": "packages/foundation/modeling/identity"

  "beep": {
    "family": "foundation",
    "kind": "modeling"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "audit": "bun run --if-present beep:audit",
    "babel": "babel dist --plugins annotate-pure-calls --out-dir dist --source-maps",
    "beep:audit": "bun run beep:build && bun run beep:check && bun run beep:test && bun run beep:lint:verbose",
    "beep:build": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.json && bun run babel",
    "beep:check": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.check.json && bun run beep:check:tests",
    "beep:check:tests": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit",
    "beep:docgen": "bunx --bun --no-install docgen",
    "beep:doctest": "BEEP_VITEST_DOCTEST=1 bunx vitest run",
    "beep:lint": "biome check . > /dev/null 2>&1",
    "beep:lint:fix": "biome check . --write",
    "beep:lint:verbose": "biome check .",
    "beep:test": "bunx vitest run",
    "build": "bun run beep:build",
    "check": "bun run beep:check",
    "codegen": "beep-cli codegen barrel",
    "coverage": "bunx vitest run --coverage",
    "docgen": "bun run beep:docgen",
    "doctest": "bun run beep:doctest",
    "lint": "bun run beep:lint",
    "lint:deprecated-apis": "beep-cli lint deprecated-apis --package .",
    "lint:fix": "bun run beep:lint:fix",
    "lint:jsdoc": "beep-cli lint jsdoc --package .",
    "lint:laws": "beep-cli lint laws --package .",
    "package-test-typecheck": "beep-cli quality test-tsgo-package",
    "test": "bun run beep:test",
    "test:property": "bun run beep:test"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./*": "./src/*.ts",
    "./internal/*": null,
    "./package.json": "./package.json",
    "./packages": "./src/packages.ts"
  },
  "files": [
    "src/**/*.ts",
    "dist/**/*.js",
    "dist/**/*.js.map",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts.map"
  ],
  "sideEffects": [],
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public",
    "provenance": true,
    "exports": {
      ".": "./dist/index.js",
      "./*": "./dist/*.js",
      "./internal/*": null,
      "./package.json": "./package.json"
    }
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "effect": "catalog:"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@beep/fc-runs": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/test-runner": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/types": "workspace:^",
    "@effect/vitest": "catalog:",
    "@types/node": "catalog:",
    "type-fest": "catalog:"
  }
}

    "test:integration": "bun run beep:test:integration",
    "test:property": "bun run beep:test"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./Lexical.behavior": "./src/Lexical.behavior.ts",
    "./Lexical.codec": "./src/Lexical.codec.ts",
    "./Lexical.conformance": "./src/Lexical.conformance.ts",
    "./Lexical.model": "./src/Lexical.model.ts",
    "./Lexical.normalize": "./src/Lexical.normalize.ts",
    "./internal/*": null,
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  },
  "files": [
    "src/**/*.ts",
    "dist/**/*.js",
    "dist/**/*.js.map",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts.map"
  ],
  "sideEffects": [],
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public",
    "provenance": true,
    "exports": {
      ".": "./dist/index.js",
      "./Lexical.behavior": "./dist/Lexical.behavior.js",
      "./Lexical.codec": "./dist/Lexical.codec.js",
      "./Lexical.conformance": "./dist/Lexical.conformance.js",
      "./Lexical.model": "./dist/Lexical.model.js",
      "./Lexical.normalize": "./dist/Lexical.normalize.js",
      "./internal/*": null,
      "./package.json": "./package.json"
    }
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@beep/identity": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/md": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/schema": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/utils": "workspace:^",
    "effect": "catalog:"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@beep/test-runner": "workspace:^",

    "@lexical/table": "catalog:",
    "@types/node": "catalog:",
    "bun-types": "catalog:",
    "lexical": "catalog:"
  }
}

packages/foundation/modeling/rdf/package.canonicalPretty:
{
  "name": "@beep/rdf",
  "version": "0.0.0",
  "description": "RDF modeling package",
  "license": "MIT",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/beep-effect/beep-effect/tree/main/packages/foundation/modeling/rdf",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git@github.com:beep-effect/beep-effect.git",
    "directory": "packages/foundation/modeling/rdf"
  },
  "beep": {
    "family": "foundation",
    "kind": "modeling"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "audit": "bun run --if-present beep:audit",
    "babel": "babel dist --plugins annotate-pure-calls --out-dir dist --source-maps",
    "beep:audit": "bun run beep:build && bun run beep:check && bun run beep:test && bun run beep:lint",
    "beep:build": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.json && bun run babel",
    "beep:check": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.check.json && bun run beep:check:tests",
    "beep:check:tests": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit",
    "beep:docgen": "bunx --bun --no-install docgen",
    "beep:doctest": "BEEP_VITEST_DOCTEST=1 bunx vitest run",
    "beep:lint": "biome check .",
    "beep:lint:fix": "biome check . --write",
    "beep:test": "bunx --bun vitest run",
    "build": "bun run beep:build",
    "check": "bun run beep:check",
    "coverage": "bunx vitest run --coverage",
    "docgen": "bun run beep:docgen",
    "doctest": "bun run beep:doctest",
    "lint": "bun run beep:lint",
    "lint:deprecated-apis": "beep-cli lint deprecated-apis --package .",
    "lint:fix": "bun run beep:lint:fix",
    "lint:jsdoc": "beep-cli lint jsdoc --package .",
    "lint:laws": "beep-cli lint laws --package .",
    "package-test-typecheck": "beep-cli quality test-tsgo-package",
    "test": "bun run beep:test",
    "test:property": "bun run beep:test"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./*": "./src/*.ts",
    "./SemanticSchemaConformance": "./src/SemanticSchemaConformance.ts",
    "./SemanticSchemaMetadata": "./src/SemanticSchemaMetadata/index.ts",
    "./SemanticSchemaMetadata/*": null,
    "./internal/*": null,
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  },
  "files": [
    "src/**/*.ts",
    "dist/**/*.js",
    "dist/**/*.js.map",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts.map"
  ],
  "sideEffects": [],
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public",
    "provenance": true,
    "exports": {
      ".": "./dist/index.js",
      "./*": "./dist/*.js",
      "./SemanticSchemaConformance": "./dist/SemanticSchemaConformance.js",
      "./SemanticSchemaMetadata": "./dist/SemanticSchemaMetadata/index.js",
      "./SemanticSchemaMetadata/*": null,
      "./internal/*": null,
      "./package.json": "./package.json"
    }
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@beep/identity": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/md": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/schema": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/utils": "workspace:^",
    "effect": "catalog:"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@beep/test-runner": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/test-utils": "workspace:^",
    "@effect/vitest": "catalog:",
    "@types/node": "catalog:",
    "bun-types": "catalog:"
  }
}

{
  "name": "@beep/semver",
  "version": "0.0.0",
  "description": "Strict SemVer 2.0.0 versions, ranges and comparators as Effect schemas",
  "license": "MIT",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/beep-effect/beep-effect/tree/main/packages/foundation/modeling/semver",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git@github.com:beep-effect/beep-effect.git",
    "directory": "packages/foundation/modeling/semver"
  },
  "beep": {
    "family": "foundation",
    "kind": "modeling"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "audit": "bun run --if-present beep:audit",
    "babel": "babel dist --plugins annotate-pure-calls --out-dir dist --source-maps",
    "beep:audit": "bun run beep:build && bun run beep:check && bun run beep:test && bun run beep:test:integration && bun run lint:laws && bun run beep:docgen && bun run beep:lint",
    "beep:build": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.json && bun run babel",
    "beep:check": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.check.json && bun run beep:check:tests",
    "beep:check:tests": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit",
    "beep:docgen": "bunx --bun --no-install docgen",
    "beep:lint": "biome check .",
    "beep:lint:fix": "biome check . --write",
    "beep:test": "bunx --bun vitest run --passWithNoTests --exclude=test/integration/**",
    "beep:test:integration": "bunx --bun vitest run test/integration --passWithNoTests",
    "build": "bun run beep:build",
    "check": "bun run beep:check",
    "coverage": "bunx vitest run --coverage --exclude=test/integration/**",
    "docgen": "bun run beep:docgen",
    "lint": "bun run beep:lint",
    "lint:deprecated-apis": "beep-cli lint deprecated-apis --package .",
    "lint:fix": "bun run beep:lint:fix",
    "lint:jsdoc": "beep-cli lint jsdoc --package .",
    "lint:laws": "beep-cli lint laws --package .",
    "package-test-typecheck": "beep-cli quality test-tsgo-package",
    "test": "bun run beep:test",
    "test:integration": "bun run beep:test:integration"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./*": "./src/*.ts",
    "./internal/*": "./src/internal/*.ts",
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  },
  "files": [
    "src/**/*.ts",
    "dist/**/*.js",
    "dist/**/*.js.map",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts.map"
  ],
  "sideEffects": [],
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public",
    "provenance": true,
    "exports": {
      ".": "./dist/index.js",
      "./*": "./dist/*.js",
      "./internal/*": "./dist/internal/*.js",
      "./package.json": "./package.json"
    }
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@beep/identity": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/schema": "workspace:^",
    "effect": "catalog:"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@beep/fc-runs": "workspace:^",
    "@effect/vitest": "catalog:",
    "@types/node": "catalog:",
    "bun-types": "catalog:"
  }
}

{
  "name": "@beep/spdx",

  "description": "SPDX license identifiers, exceptions and expressions as Effect schemas",

  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/beep-effect/beep-effect/tree/main/packages/foundation/modeling/spdx",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git@github.com:beep-effect/beep-effect.git",
    "directory": "packages/foundation/modeling/spdx"
  },
  "beep": {
    "family": "foundation",
    "kind": "modeling"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "audit": "bun run --if-present beep:audit",
    "babel": "babel dist --plugins annotate-pure-calls --out-dir dist --source-maps",
    "beep:audit": "bun run beep:build && bun run beep:check && bun run beep:test && bun run beep:test:integration && bun run lint:laws && bun run beep:docgen && bun run beep:lint",
    "beep:build": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.json && bun run babel",
    "beep:check": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.check.json && bun run beep:check:tests",
    "beep:check:tests": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit",
    "beep:docgen": "bunx --bun --no-install docgen",
    "beep:lint": "biome check .",
    "beep:lint:fix": "biome check . --write",
    "beep:test": "bunx --bun vitest run --passWithNoTests --exclude=test/integration/**",
    "beep:test:integration": "bunx --bun vitest run test/integration --passWithNoTests",
    "build": "bun run beep:build",
    "check": "bun run beep:check",
    "coverage": "bunx vitest run --coverage --exclude=test/integration/**",
    "docgen": "bun run beep:docgen",
    "lint": "bun run beep:lint",
    "lint:deprecated-apis": "beep-cli lint deprecated-apis --package .",
    "lint:fix": "bun run beep:lint:fix",
    "lint:jsdoc": "beep-cli lint jsdoc --package .",
    "lint:laws": "beep-cli lint laws --package .",
    "package-test-typecheck": "beep-cli quality test-tsgo-package",
    "test": "bun run beep:test",
    "test:integration": "bun run beep:test:integration"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./*": "./src/*.ts",
    "./internal/*": "./src/internal/*.ts",
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  },
  "files": [
    "src/**/*.ts",
    "dist/**/*.js",
    "dist/**/*.js.map",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts.map"
  ],
  "sideEffects": [],
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public",
    "provenance": true,
    "exports": {
      ".": "./dist/index.js",
      "./*": "./dist/*.js",
      "./internal/*": "./dist/internal/*.js",
      "./package.json": "./package.json"
    }
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@beep/identity": "workspace:^",
    "effect": "catalog:"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@beep/fc-runs": "workspace:^",
    "@effect/vitest": "catalog:",
    "@types/node": "catalog:",
    "bun-types": "catalog:",
    "spdx-expression-parse": "5.0.0"
  }
}

{
  "name": "@beep/brand",
  "version": "0.0.0",
  "description": "beep brand identity: marks, palette, typography tokens, and static assets",
  "license": "MIT",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/beep-effect/beep-effect/tree/main/packages/foundation/ui-system/brand",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git@github.com:beep-effect/beep-effect.git",
    "directory": "packages/foundation/ui-system/brand"
  },
  "beep": {
    "family": "foundation",
    "kind": "ui-system"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "audit": "bun run --if-present beep:audit",
    "babel": "babel dist --plugins annotate-pure-calls --out-dir dist --source-maps",
    "beep:audit": "bun run beep:build && bun run beep:check && bun run beep:test && bun run beep:test:integration && bun run beep:lint",
    "beep:build": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.json && bun run babel",
    "beep:check": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.check.json && bun run beep:check:tests",
    "beep:check:tests": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit",
    "beep:docgen": "bunx --bun --no-install docgen",
    "beep:lint": "biome check .",
    "beep:lint:fix": "biome check . --write",
    "beep:test": "bunx --bun vitest run --passWithNoTests --exclude=test/integration/**",
    "beep:test:integration": "bunx --bun vitest run test/integration --passWithNoTests",
    "build": "bun run beep:build",
    "check": "bun run beep:check",
    "coverage": "bunx vitest run --coverage --exclude=test/integration/**",
    "docgen": "bun run beep:docgen",
    "lint": "bun run beep:lint",
    "lint:deprecated-apis": "beep-cli lint deprecated-apis --package .",
    "lint:fix": "bun run beep:lint:fix",
    "lint:jsdoc": "beep-cli lint jsdoc --package .",
    "lint:laws": "beep-cli lint laws --package .",
    "package-test-typecheck": "beep-cli quality test-tsgo-package",
    "render": "bun run scripts/render.ts",
    "test": "bun run beep:test",
    "test:integration": "bun run beep:test:integration"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./assets/*": {
      "default": "./assets/*",
      "types": "./src/Brand.asset.d.ts"
    },
    "./package.json": "./package.json",
    "./react": "./src/react.tsx",
    "./styles/*": "./styles/*"
  },
  "files": [
    "assets/**",
    "styles/**",
    "src/**/*.ts",
    "src/**/*.tsx",
    "dist/**/*.js",
    "dist/**/*.js.map",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts.map"
  ],
  "sideEffects": [
    "**/*.css"
  ],
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public",
    "provenance": true,
    "exports": {
      ".": "./dist/index.js",
      "./assets/*": {
        "default": "./assets/*",
        "types": "./src/Brand.asset.d.ts"
      },
      "./package.json": "./package.json",
      "./react": "./dist/react.js",
      "./styles/*": "./styles/*"
    }
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@beep/identity": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/schema": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/utils": "workspace:^",
    "effect": "catalog:"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@beep/test-runner": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/test-utils": "workspace:^",
    "@effect/platform-bun": "catalog:",
    "@effect/vitest": "catalog:",
    "@testing-library/react": "catalog:",
    "@types/node": "catalog:",
    "@types/react": "catalog:",
    "@types/react-dom": "catalog:",
    "bun-types": "catalog:",
    "jsdom": "catalog:",
    "react": "catalog:",
    "react-dom": "catalog:",
    "vitest": "catalog:"
  },
  "peerDependencies": {
    "react": "^19"
  },
  "peerDependenciesMeta": {
    "react": {
      "optional": true
    }
  }
}

    "@beep/test-runner": "workspace:^",

  }
}

  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./aggregates/*": "./src/aggregates/*/index.ts",
    "./aggregates/Session/metrics": "./src/aggregates/Session/Session.metrics.tsx",
    "./aggregates/Session/sparql": "./src/aggregates/Session/Session.sparql.tsx",
    "./aggregates/Session/validation": "./src/aggregates/Session/Session.validation.tsx",
    "./internal/*": null,
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  },
  "files": [
    "src/**/*.ts",
    "dist/**/*.js",

    "dist/**/*.d.ts",

  ],
  "sideEffects": [],
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public",

    "exports": {
      ".": "./dist/index.js",
      "./aggregates/*": "./dist/aggregates/*/index.js",
      "./aggregates/Session/metrics": "./dist/aggregates/Session/Session.metrics.js",
      "./aggregates/Session/sparql": "./dist/aggregates/Session/Session.sparql.js",
      "./aggregates/Session/validation": "./dist/aggregates/Session/Session.validation.js",
      "./internal/*": null,
      "./package.json": "./package.json"

  "dependencies": {
    "@beep/ontology-client": "workspace:^",

    "coverage": "bunx vitest run --coverage",

    "lint:laws": "beep-cli lint laws --package .",
    "package-test-typecheck": "beep-cli quality test-tsgo-package",
    "test": "bun run beep:test",
    "test:property": "bun run beep:test"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./*": "./src/*.ts",
    "./JSDoc/models/tag-values": "./src/JSDoc/models/tag-values/index.ts",
    "./internal/*": null,
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  },
  "files": [
    "src/**/*.ts",
    "dist/**/*.js",
    "dist/**/*.js.map",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts.map"
  ],
  "sideEffects": [],
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public",
    "provenance": true,
    "exports": {
      ".": "./dist/index.js",
      "./*": "./dist/*.js",
      "./JSDoc/models/tag-values": "./dist/JSDoc/models/tag-values/index.js",
      "./internal/*": null,
      "./package.json": "./package.json"
    }
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@beep/glob": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/identity": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/package-json": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/schema": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/utils": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/walker": "workspace:^",
    "@biomejs/biome": "catalog:",
    "@effect/platform-node": "catalog:",
    "@effect/tsgo": "catalog:",
    "@standard-schema/spec": "catalog:",
    "@typescript/native": "catalog:",
    "effect": "catalog:",
    "ts-morph": "catalog:"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@beep/memfs": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/test-runner": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/test-utils": "workspace:^",
    "@effect/vitest": "catalog:",
    "@types/node": "catalog:",
    "bun-types": "catalog:"
  }
}

{
  "name": "@beep/lint-rules",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Repo-local Biome GritQL and oxlint rules for Effect-aligned quality enforcement",
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/beep-effect/beep-effect/tree/main/packages/tooling/policy-pack/lint-rules",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git@github.com:beep-effect/beep-effect.git",
    "directory": "packages/tooling/policy-pack/lint-rules"
  },
  "beep": {
    "family": "tooling",
    "kind": "policy-pack"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "audit": "bun run --if-present beep:audit",
    "beep:audit": "bun run beep:build && bun run beep:check && bun run beep:test && bun run beep:lint",
    "beep:build": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.json",
    "beep:check": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.check.json && bun run beep:check:tests",
    "beep:check:tests": "tsc-rs -p test/tsconfig.json --noEmit",
    "beep:docgen": "bunx --bun --no-install docgen",
    "beep:lint": "biome check .",
    "beep:lint:fix": "biome check . --write",
    "beep:test": "bunx --bun vitest run",
    "build": "bun run beep:build",
    "check": "bun run beep:check",
    "coverage": "bunx vitest run --coverage",
    "docgen": "bun run beep:docgen",
    "lint": "bun run beep:lint",
    "lint:deprecated-apis": "beep-cli lint deprecated-apis --package .",
    "lint:fix": "bun run beep:lint:fix",
    "lint:jsdoc": "beep-cli lint jsdoc --package .",
    "lint:laws": "beep-cli lint laws --package .",
    "package-test-typecheck": "beep-cli quality test-tsgo-package",
    "test": "bun run beep:test",
    "test:property": "bun run beep:test"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./core": "./configs/core.jsonc",
    "./oxlint": "./src/rules/index.ts",
    "./oxlint-docs": "./src/rules/docs.index.ts",
    "./package.json": "./package.json",
    "./recommended": "./configs/core.jsonc",
    "./schema": "./configs/schema.jsonc",
    "./services": "./configs/services.jsonc"
  },
  "files": [
    "src/**/*.ts",
    "rules/*.grit",
    "configs/*.jsonc",
    "docs/**/*.md",
    "dist/**/*.js",
    "dist/**/*.js.map",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts.map"
  ],
  "sideEffects": [],
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public",
    "provenance": true,
    "exports": {
      ".": "./dist/index.js",
      "./core": "./configs/core.jsonc",
      "./package.json": "./package.json",
      "./recommended": "./configs/core.jsonc",
      "./schema": "./configs/schema.jsonc",
      "./services": "./configs/services.jsonc"
    }
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@beep/identity": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/schema": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/test-runner": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/test-utils": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/utils": "workspace:^",
    "@biomejs/biome": "catalog:",
    "@effect/platform-node": "catalog:",
    "@microsoft/tsdoc": "catalog:",
    "@microsoft/tsdoc-config": "catalog:",
    "@oxlint/plugins": "catalog:",
    "@types/node": "catalog:",
    "are-docs-informative": "catalog:",
    "comment-parser": "catalog:",
    "effect": "catalog:",
    "oxlint": "catalog:"
  }
}

    "test:integration": "bun run beep:test:integration",
    "test:integration:serial": "bun run beep:test:integration",
    "test:property": "bun run beep:test"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./*": "./src/*.ts",
    "./ConformanceLedger": "./src/ConformanceLedger/index.ts",
    "./ConformanceLedger/*": null,
    "./internal/*": null,
    "./package.json": "./package.json",
    "./test/*": null,
    "./test/Vitest": "./src/test/Vitest.test-kit.ts"
  },

    "src/**/*.ts",

  ],

    "access": "public",

{
  "name": "@beep/repo-docgen",
  "version": "0.0.2",
  "description": "An opinionated documentation generator for beep-effect",
  "license": "MIT",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/beep-effect/beep-effect/tree/main/packages/tooling/tool/docgen",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git@github.com:beep-effect/beep-effect.git",
    "directory": "packages/tooling/tool/docgen"
  },
  "beep": {
    "family": "tooling",
    "kind": "tool"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "audit": "bun run --if-present beep:audit",
    "babel": "babel dist --plugins annotate-pure-calls --out-dir dist --source-maps",
    "beep:audit": "bun run beep:build && bun run beep:check && bun run beep:test && bun run beep:lint",
    "beep:build": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.json && bun run babel",
    "beep:check": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.check.json && bun run beep:check:tests",
    "beep:check:tests": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit",
    "beep:docgen": "bun run src/bin.ts",
    "beep:lint": "biome check .",
    "beep:lint:fix": "biome check . --write",
    "beep:test": "bunx --bun vitest run",
    "build": "bun run beep:build",
    "check": "bun run beep:check",
    "coverage": "bunx vitest run --coverage",
    "docgen": "bun run beep:docgen",
    "docs:aggregate": "bunx --bun --no-install beep-cli docs aggregate --clean",
    "lint": "bun run beep:lint",
    "lint:deprecated-apis": "beep-cli lint deprecated-apis --package .",
    "lint:fix": "bun run beep:lint:fix",
    "lint:jsdoc": "beep-cli lint jsdoc --package .",
    "lint:laws": "beep-cli lint laws --package .",
    "package-test-typecheck": "beep-cli quality test-tsgo-package",
    "test": "bun run beep:test",
    "test:property": "bun run beep:test"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./*": "./src/*.ts",
    "./internal/*": null,
    "./package.json": "./package.json",
    "./schema.json": "./schema.json"
  },
  "bin": {
    "docgen": "./src/bin.ts"
  },
  "files": [
    "src/**/*.ts",
    "dist/**/*.js",
    "dist/**/*.js.map",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts.map"
  ],
  "sideEffects": [],
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public",
    "provenance": true,
    "exports": {
      ".": "./dist/index.ts",
      "./*": "./dist/*.js",
      "./internal/*": null,
      "./package.json": "./package.json"
    }
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@babel/code-frame": "catalog:",
    "@beep/chalk": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/config-file": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/identity": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/md": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/package-json": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/repo-utils": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/schema": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/utils": "workspace:^",
    "@effect/markdown-toc": "catalog:",
    "@effect/platform-bun": "catalog:",
    "doctrine": "catalog:",
    "effect": "catalog:",
    "ts-morph": "catalog:"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@beep/test-runner": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/test-utils": "workspace:^",
    "@effect/vitest": "catalog:",
    "@types/babel__code-frame": "catalog:",
    "@types/doctrine": "catalog:",
    "@types/node": "catalog:"
  }
}

{
  "name": "@beep/workspace-server",
  "version": "0.0.0",
  "description": "Workspace server adapter package for the ThreadStore repository and Layers.",
  "license": "MIT",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/beep-effect/beep-effect/tree/main/packages/workspace/server",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git@github.com:beep-effect/beep-effect.git",
    "directory": "packages/workspace/server"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "audit": "bun run --if-present beep:audit",
    "babel": "babel dist --plugins annotate-pure-calls --out-dir dist --source-maps",
    "beep:audit": "bun run beep:build && bun run beep:check && bun run beep:test && bun run beep:test:integration && bun run beep:lint",
    "beep:build": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.json && bun run babel",
    "beep:check": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.check.json && bun run beep:check:tests",
    "beep:check:tests": "tsc-rs -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit",
    "beep:docgen": "bunx --bun --no-install docgen",
    "beep:lint": "biome check .",
    "beep:lint:fix": "biome check . --write",
    "beep:test": "bunx --bun vitest run --passWithNoTests --exclude=test/integration/**",
    "beep:test:integration": "bunx --bun vitest run test/integration --passWithNoTests",
    "build": "bun run beep:build",
    "check": "bun run beep:check",
    "coverage": "bunx vitest run --coverage --exclude=test/integration/**",
    "docgen": "bun run beep:docgen",
    "lint": "bun run beep:lint",
    "lint:deprecated-apis": "beep-cli lint deprecated-apis --package .",
    "lint:fix": "bun run beep:lint:fix",
    "lint:jsdoc": "beep-cli lint jsdoc --package .",
    "lint:laws": "beep-cli lint laws --package .",
    "package-test-typecheck": "beep-cli quality test-tsgo-package",
    "test": "bun run beep:test",
    "test:integration": "bun run beep:test:integration",
    "test:integration:parallel": "bun run beep:test:integration",
    "test:property": "bun run beep:test"
  },
  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./SourceText": "./src/SourceText/index.ts",
    "./aggregates/Thread": "./src/aggregates/Thread/index.ts",
    "./aggregates/Workspace": "./src/aggregates/Workspace/index.ts",
    "./internal/*": null,
    "./layer": "./src/Layer.ts",
    "./package.json": "./package.json",
    "./test": "./src/test.ts"
  },
  "files": [
    "src/**/*.ts",
    "dist/**/*.js",
    "dist/**/*.js.map",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts",
    "dist/**/*.d.ts.map"
  ],
  "sideEffects": [],
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public",
    "provenance": true,
    "exports": {
      ".": "./dist/index.ts",
      "./SourceText": "./dist/SourceText/index.js",
      "./aggregates/Thread": "./dist/aggregates/Thread/index.js",
      "./aggregates/Workspace": "./dist/aggregates/Workspace/index.js",
      "./internal/*": null,
      "./layer": "./dist/Layer.js",
      "./package.json": "./package.json",
      "./test": "./dist/test.js"
    }
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@beep/doc-text": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/file-processing": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/identity": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/md": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/postgres": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/provenance": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/schema": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/shared-domain": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/utils": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/workspace-domain": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/workspace-tables": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/workspace-use-cases": "workspace:^",
    "drizzle-orm": "catalog:",
    "effect": "catalog:"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@beep/memfs": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/test-runner": "workspace:^",
    "@beep/test-utils": "workspace:^",
    "@effect/platform-bun": "catalog:",
    "@effect/vitest": "catalog:",
    "@electric-sql/pglite": "catalog:",
    "@types/node": "catalog:",
    "bun-types": "catalog:",
    "docx": "catalog:"
  }
}
